scope: Historical build-source candidates for the eleven profiles whose exact pinned WASM lacks an identified core revision self-report, plus SDK release correlation for all fifty profiles.
method: Read-only primary-source public GitLab pipeline/job APIs, commit-pinned GitHub source files and official SDK release metadata. Rehash the 100 original catalog binaries from retained files. This CI/SDK research performed no binary rebuild. No erased job trace endpoint was retried. Job source candidates remain distinct from exact binary/source provenance.

sdkContext.limitations: The compiler self-report matches a dependency revision in this official SDK release. The actual container digest, SDK installation and all runtime/core object toolchains used per pair remain unverified. SDK archive was inspected by HEAD only, so its binary SHA256 was not calculated.

beetlePceFastSourceFingerprint.limitations: The source literal fingerprint favors the later Oct30 candidate and excludes the earlier candidate unmodified source. These literals do not establish the complete working tree, dependency closure, flags or exact binary-to-job linkage.
beetlePceFastSourceFingerprint.method: Read the commit API patch for libretro_core_options_intl.h, select added/removed C string literals without backslash escapes, encode their complete values as UTF-8 and search the exact catalog WASM bytes. Store each source macro, literal hash, byte length and binary offset. A binary offset of -1 means absent.
